caption: The drawing depicts a horse-drawn streetcar with two white horses at the front, both harnessed with red straps and black hoofs visible. The streetcar itself has a white upper section with arched windows, a blue lower section, and a red roof, with a small green rectangular opening on top. The words "BROADWAY & 4th AVENUE" are written in red above the windows on the side of the streetcar. There is a decorative pink and purple floral motif below the windows on the side panel. Four large wooden wheels with yellow axle points support the streetcar. A driver, dressed in a blue, yellow, and green jacket with a red shoulder cape, is seated at the front, holding reins that connect to the horses. The background is blank and uncolored, focusing all attention on the streetcar and horses.
title: Toy Bus
